def solve(inp):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    threes=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==3]
    def nb3(r,c):
        return sum(0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W and g[r+dr][c+dc]==3 for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)))
    interior3=[(r,c) for r,c in threes if nb3(r,c)==0]
    assert len(interior3)==1, interior3
    (cr,cc),=interior3
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if any(g[r][c]==3 for c in range(W))]
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if any(g[r][c]==3 for r in range(H))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            if (r,c)==(cr,cc): continue
            d=max(abs(r-cr),abs(c-cc))
            g[r][c]= 4 if d%2==1 else 2
    return g
